# Requirements Quality Checklist: Currency Converter

**Purpose**: Review completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of the Currency Converter requirements.
**Created**: 2026-11-17
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Does the specification state whether users can choose the requested rate date, or whether the application always requests the current date? [Gap, Spec §FR-004, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the timing and trigger for obtaining rates defined, including initial launch and a same-currency conversion before rates are loaded? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, FR-011]
- [ ] CHK003 Are currency selector contents and availability defined when no network response or cache is available? [Gap, Spec §FR-002, FR-018]
- [ ] CHK004 Are cache read, write, corrupt-data, and permission failures distinguished sufficiently to define user-facing recovery? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017–FR-018, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 Is retention of multiple successful rate responses, including any limit or replacement policy, specified consistently with saving every valid response? [Gap, Spec §FR-022–FR-025]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Does “within 14 calendar days” unambiguously state whether the requested day is included in the limit or whether 14 prior days are searched? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK007 Is “empty response” defined precisely enough to distinguish a valid no-rates response from an empty HTTP body, no-rate XML document, and unsuccessful HTTP status? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-019, FR-021]
- [ ] CHK008 Are thousands/grouping separators explicitly allowed or prohibited so that inputs such as `1,234` cannot be interpreted inconsistently? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the accepted decimal grammar clear about leading zeros, surrounding whitespace, and whether a sign character is permitted before validation rejects negative amounts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the supported amount range or maximum precision defined, given the requirement to reject values that exceed an unspecified supported range? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the HTTP timeout or user-visible waiting bound specified for rate retrieval and the multi-day search? [Gap, Spec §FR-028, FR-030]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Are same-currency conversion without network access and currency selectors populated from rate data reconciled for a first launch with no rates? [Conflict, Spec §FR-002, FR-011; Plan §Architecture]
- [ ] CHK013 Are the “latest valid cache” selection rule and the requirement to save every successful response consistent about which effective date is used offline? [Consistency, Spec §FR-017, FR-022–FR-024; Data Model §Cached Rate Set]
- [ ] CHK014 Does the specification consistently describe cached fallback for network loss, HTTP errors, and failure to find rates within the backward-search period? [Consistency, Spec §FR-017–FR-020]
- [ ] CHK015 Is a BNM response with a valid structure but an effective date different from the requested date explicitly accepted or rejected? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-012, FR-019]
- [ ] CHK016 Are the rounding rule and two-decimal display requirement consistent across ordinary and same-currency conversions, including midpoint cases? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010–FR-011, SC-003]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK017 Do the success criteria include concrete known rate inputs and expected numerical outputs for EUR-to-MDL, MDL-to-EUR, and foreign-to-foreign conversions? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–SC-003]
- [ ] CHK018 Are the “clear”, “understandable”, “clean, modern”, and “responsive” outcomes given objective acceptance criteria or clearly left as reviewer-assessed qualities? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018, FR-027–FR-030, SC-005, SC-009]
- [ ] CHK019 Can the effective-date, source, and live/cache transparency criteria be assessed independently for live rates, backward-date rates, cached rates, and same-currency results? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012–FR-013, FR-026, FR-029, SC-008]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK020 Are expected outcomes defined when the cache is absent, corrupt, unreadable, or missing one of the selected currencies? [Coverage, Spec §FR-017–FR-021, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK021 Are duplicate currency codes, an invalid or absent XML effective date, and an empty but well-formed rate collection explicitly classified as whole-response failures or no-rate dates? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005, FR-019, FR-021]
- [ ] CHK022 Are rate retrieval recovery requirements clear when a prior-date search is interrupted by a network error or malformed response after one or more empty dates? [Gap, Spec §FR-016–FR-021]
- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements for rate refresh while an earlier result is visible clear about whether the old result remains labeled with its original rate provenance? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012, FR-026, FR-028–FR-030, Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK024 Are accessibility expectations for keyboard use, focus, and assistive feedback specified for the required desktop controls and status messages? [Gap, Spec §FR-001–FR-003, FR-027]
- [ ] CHK025 Are localization expectations for currency names, effective dates, amount entry, and result formatting explicit beyond accepting comma or period input? [Gap, Spec §FR-012, FR-015, FR-027]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK026 Is the external BNM dependency's expected behavior documented for HTTP status failures, timeouts, response encoding, and rate limiting? [Dependency, Spec §FR-004, FR-016, FR-019]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the assumption that a 14-calendar-day search is sufficient validated or explicitly accepted as a product boundary? [Assumption, Spec §FR-019, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the policy for using an old cached rate set defined when it is valid but its effective date is substantially older than the requested date? [Gap, Spec §FR-017, FR-026]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Add comments or findings inline.
- Link to relevant resources or documentation.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference.
